scientific_integrity: An analytic proof supplies the unbounded-gain latency law; finite numerical recurrence and rational examples verify instances only. Search and source inspection do not prove global novelty.
scientific_limitations: Exact on the boundary-initialized Euclidean-ball quadratic with deterministic full gradients and exact projection; no general convex-objective, accelerated, stochastic, or floating-point guarantee. The preceding algorithm and standard projection identities are prior work.
title: Exact boundary-flip latency for a gradient-mapping adaptive proximal method
